reviewNotes: The final twenty-one color-collection and Desert Festival challenge strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover canonical cavern, monster, geode, ore, and shard terminology, quantities, typed placeholders, color objectives, and concise challenge wording; both found no remaining objective issue.
